_doc: Values of run XUCV (logs/XUCV.events.txt, logs/XUCV.RUN_INFO, logs/XUCV.time.txt, logs/XUCV.image.elf): simulation (simulate.sh) of a git archive of commit de85565 of branch platform-all (round r12: repo_state=archive, no tag) of car_v (CAR-V, 23 tasks, 4x4 mesh) with the release by tick (RELEASE_MASK=65535, release=tick), the UCX-OS kernel without nested interrupts (isr=no_nesting), the crt0.s with the return test of _isr and the read back of _interrupt_set(0) (crt0=guard_readback) and the event-triggered injection of the packets between PEs (INJECTION=finish: a job injects its packet when it sends it; injection=finish and costs=csv in RUN_INFO) at F_CLK = 380 MHz, 11.5 ms of platform time, Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0, 2026-11-18 (experiments/REGENERATE.md: INJECTION=finish F_CLK=380000000 experiments/exp23/simulate.sh <out> 11500000 car_v 4x4). Analysis: make -C experiments/car-v-rtl analyze check-run phase-check LOG=logs/XUCV.events.txt REF=reference_XUCV.json OUTDIR=build/results_XUCV (python -m rttools.paper.rtlapp, release rule tick from the RUN_INFO; link schedule of arch/hermes-4x4.gml with o_i = L0 + 20 (m + 1)). Round r12: the image has the critical section around the queue of a task (lib/noc.c, every image of this tree); this run replaces runs TCV (tag r11-rc3, crt0.s of that tag) and UCV (tag r11-rc5) as the run with the event-triggered injection: the kernel of this tree has one crt0.s.
